about_the_game:
Step onto the footplate and embark on a special journey as Thomas the Tank Engine makes his debut in Train Sim World 5! Drive with Thomas as he makes his way to the West Somerset Railway with Annie and Clarabel. Diesel’s also tagging along for the ride, what mischief will he get up to?

Following an invitation from the mainland, Sir Topham Hatt has been asked if his engines can visit the West Somerset Railway for a special weekend where people can see the North Western Railway’s finest. Sir Topham Hatt has decided to let Thomas go and visit the mainland with Annie and Clarabel! Operate special trains along the mainland’s longest standard gauge heritage railway.

But wait! Diesel is being his mischievous self, and wants to join in on the adventure… He’s followed Thomas to West Somerset and is determined to play tricks on him and prove that he is Sir Topham Hatt’s most useful engine. Work around Diesel’s tricks to avoid confusion and delay.

Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends™ Visit the West Somerset Railway brings Thomas, Annie, Clarabel, Diesel, Troublesome Trucks to TSW5. In the narrated story-based scenarios, interact with Sir Topham Hatt and complete tasks on the West Somerset Railway. In an additional timetable, drive services across the line, and in Free Roam, take Thomas and his friends onto any route in your collection.

Enjoy the delight as a lifelong fan of the North Western Railway’s number 1 engine with TSW5: Thomas & Friends™ Visit the WSR!

Please Note: Train Sim World 5: West Somerset Railway is required, as a separate purchase, in order to utilise the content featured in this add-on.

Key Features

  • Drive with Thomas the Tank Engine and Diesel as they visit from the Island of Sodor

  • Carry passengers with Annie and Clarabel, or travel in them yourself

  • Shunt and shove Troublesome Trucks

  • Play through a multi-part story on the West Somerset Railway, complete with narration and character interactions

  • Accessible Tutorials on the Train Sim World Training Center to learn how to drive with Thomas and Diesel – this can be enjoyed by anyone!

  • Run Thomas and Diesel on an additional West Somerset Railway timetable

  • Take the tour anywhere, Thomas and Diesel can travel on any route in your collection with Free Roam

  • Scenario Planner and Formation Designer (with Thomas & Friends™ content only) compatible. Share your formations and scenarios with the Creators Club. Livery Designer is not supported

  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology

  • Download size: 630 MB
